notes.title: Fear The Reaper Beta Phase Begins Now!
notes.notes: [p]I'm happy to announce that we're officially entering BETA PHASE. From now on, we will be regularly testing the game with the community, with the goal of improving it and making sure that it's as balanced as it can be and the technical quality is up to a high standard. [/p][p]As we go, each beta test will open up to more and more players, culminating in at least one big open test. But to get there, I will need your help. Let's try and make a game we can all enjoy for years to come. This step is about making sure that the foundation is rock solid.[/p][p]The first test will take place on Friday, July 18th.[/p][p]This first test is Founder only. Founders will get to play first, as a thank you for helping me reach this milestone a little sooner with their support. A smaller test will also be a great opportunity to work out any problems before opening it up to more players. The game will be playable until Sunday, July 20th. If you haven't purchased the Founder's Pack yet and would like to be part of this first test, hop in our Discord for information on how to get it.[/p][p]Beta keys will be distributed to Founders in the following days, giving us enough time to make sure each Founder has received their key.[/p][p]After the first test expect a Discord announcement with instructions on how to register as a non-Founder for the next one. Be sure to join it if you haven't yet![/p][p]See you in the game soon, I hope you all have a blast.[/p][p][/p]
